findings.text: No test covers deep-link resolution in useRouting: the pendingDetail effect (company slug found -> setSelCo/setFromView('directory'); unknown slug -> setView('404')) and parseURL-driven initial state are never exercised. useRouting.test.jsx always sets the path to '/stuttgart' (view 'home', detailParam null) and never loads /stuttgart/company/<slug>, /jobs/<id> or an unknown sub-path.

The popstate handler in useRouting (company found -> setSelCo + fromView from e.state.from; not found -> '404'; other -> setView(newView); scrollTo) and the history.replaceState/scrollRestoration init effect have no assertion; a regression (e.g. wrong dependency on [companies]) would not fail any test.

findings.ac: AC2 filters, search queries, modals function identically
findings.text: AC explicitly names filters, search queries and modals, but no test asserts any of them (no App-level or filter/search test). The only filter link is a vi.fn() resetFilters in useRouting.test.jsx checked with toHaveBeenCalled (so the real App reset() clearing sectorF/remoteF/q/inputQ/dF is not verified), and nothing checks search/filter output (fCo) after extraction.

useEcosystemData.test.jsx mocks only isConfigured:true with a matching region. Untested: catch-path fallback to MOCK_COMPANIES/MOCK_JOBS with region 'Stuttgart' and dataSource 'mock'; isConfigured=false mock branch; no-active-region 'landing' branch (fetchCompanies() all-regions, dataSource 'landing'); single-region redirect to '/'+regions[0].id including the new parseURL().view universal-view exemption (changed from the old `view` state); the cancelled flag.

findings.ac: AC2 / PRD s7 deterministic sector and job-function lookups
findings.text: Mocks return fetchSectors/fetchJobFunctions/fetchRegions data but the test never asserts sectorDefs, jobFuncDefs, allRegions, activeRegion, jobs, or the derived short region name (label 'Stuttgart' has no separator so the split(/\s*[&·,]/) logic is not exercised). Test 1 only asserts companies toBeDefined (existence only). Removal of the _sectorDefs/_jobFuncDefs globals relies on props with no test proving the maps are populated.

nav and goTo are tested only for the happy path (nav('directory'), goTo existing slug). Not asserted: nav('home') path '/<slug>', no pushState when v === view, no-region branch (universal view -> '/about', other -> window.location.href='/'), goTo with unknown slug leaving view unchanged, scrollTo(0,0).

findings.ac: AC1 npm run build completes with zero errors
findings.text: No test, script or CI step in the diff asserts the build; the vitest suite does not import App.jsx, so a broken import or removed identifier in App.jsx (e.g. unused fetch imports left, isConfigured/useCallback/UNIVERSAL_VIEWS use) would not fail any test. Only a manual npm run build would catch it.

No assertion or measurement for latency/render behavior. The fetch effect dependency changed from [] to [regionSlug] and resetFilters (an inline reset arrow recreated each render) is now a dependency of nav's useCallback, making nav identity unstable each render; nothing tests that fetch is called once or that rerenders are unchanged.

findings.ac: Slice Path: Logic Layer file names
findings.text: Issue Path specifies src/hooks/useAppData.js and src/hooks/useDeepLinkRouting.js; snapshot has src/useEcosystemData.js and src/useRouting.js and no src/hooks directory. No AC states it and the PRD says flat layout, so non-blocking, but no test or doc maps this deviation.
